newsitem.title: USA: Union Carbide says two segments balance off.
newsitem.headline: Union Carbide says two segments balance off.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said Monday said the third quarter increase in the operating profit of its specialities and intermediates segment was offset by its basic chemicals and polymers segment.
The specialties and intermediates segment's operating profit grew to $202 million from $115 million in the same period in the prior year.

However, its basic chemicals and polymers segment, which the company described as "cyclical," posted a smaller operating profit of $40 million for the third quarter compared with $121 million for the same period in the prior year.

Union Carbide said the basic chemicals and polymers segment reflected the combination of weak pricing for ethylene glycol and a rapid rise in feedstock costs, which were only partly offset by an improvement in polyethylene prices.
